newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - ABS says problems with some capital data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - ABS says problems with some capital data.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics said the net capital transactions section of monthly balance of payments releases are not available because of problems with the quality of data for non-resident holdings of general government securities domiciled in Australia.

They will not be available until this issue is resolved, the ABS said in a note accompanuying the November balance of payments. The ABS said the estimate for the net income deficit is based on extrapolation of quarterly results since the preliminary results of the survey of international investment are not yet available. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
